nodes.text:
In response to the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) outbreak in China and five reported cases in India, Mizoram's government has set up a Core Committee led by Health Minister Lalrinpuii to address the situation.
Rapid Response Teams have been formed at state and district levels. https://t.co/XxpnFvbmaK
